question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A book or paper written by hand
solution: The correct answer is '**Manuscript**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Manuscript**'. • It means 'a very old book or document that was written by hand'. (हस्‍तलिखित अति प्राचीन ग्रंथ या दस्‍तावेज़) • *Example: The library owns the author's original **manuscript**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Manuscript.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Edition**: the form in which a book is published; all the books, newspapers, etc. published in the same form at the same time. (पुस्‍तक का प्रकाशित रूप, संस्‍करण; एक ही समय और रूपाकार में प्रकाशित समस्‍त पुस्‍तकें, समाचार-पत्र आदि) • **Periodical**: a magazine that is produced regularly. (नियत समय पर प्रकाशित होने वाली पत्रिका; नियतकालिक) • **Paperback**: a book that has a paper cover. (काग़ज़ के जि़ल्‍द की पुस्‍तक; पेपरबैक) 38:Tb49, The correct answer is '**Martyr**'.
